name: eClinicalWorks AI Scribe (Sunoh.ai)
description: eClinicalWorks built Sunoh.ai—an ambient AI medical scribe—directly into V12 of its EHR. Unlike athenahealth's free approach, Sunoh is sold as an add-on starting at $149/provider/month. It uses ambient listening to convert natural patient-provider conversations into clinical documentation. Sold through eClinicalWorks/healow sales channels (no self-serve signup). Some users report a one-time setup fee (amount varies). Third-party alternatives like DeepCura ($129/mo including $50 eCW API fee) or Freed ($39-119/mo browser extension) may be more cost-effective. Important: eClinicalWorks charges a $50/mo API access fee for third-party AI scribes with bidirectional integration.

faqs.q: How much does eClinicalWorks AI Scribe cost in 2026?
faqs.a: eClinicalWorks AI Scribe (Sunoh.ai) starts at $149/provider/month as an add-on to eClinicalWorks V12. This is 'limited-time' introductory pricing. Some users report one-time setup fees (amount varies). Contact eCW/healow sales for exact quotes.

faqs.q: Is eClinicalWorks AI Scribe cheaper than third-party options?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Sunoh.ai at $149/mo is more expensive than Freed ($39-119/mo browser extension) or DeepCura ($129/mo including $50 eCW API fee). However, native integration may justify the premium for some practices.

faqs.q: What is the eClinicalWorks API fee for third-party AI scribes?
faqs.a: eClinicalWorks charges a $50/month API access fee for third-party AI scribes with bidirectional integration. DeepCura's $129/mo price includes this fee. This is an important cost consideration when comparing alternatives.

faqs.q: Can I try eClinicalWorks AI Scribe before buying?
faqs.a: Unlike standalone AI scribes with free trials, Sunoh.ai is sold through eCW/healow sales channels with no self-serve signup. You must engage with sales to explore the product.

faqs.q: eClinicalWorks AI Scribe vs Freed vs DeepCura: which is better?
faqs.a: Sunoh.ai ($149/mo) offers native eCW integration. Freed ($39-119/mo) works via browser extension. DeepCura ($129/mo including API fee) has bidirectional integration. For budget-first, Freed. For native simplicity, Sunoh. For bidirectional plus features, DeepCura.
